content.title: Kirby (KEX) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
content.summary: Shares of marine transportation service company Kirby (NYSE:KEX) jumped 5% in the morning session after the stock's positive momentum continued as the company reported third-quarter earnings that surpassed analyst expectations and earned a price target increase. Kirby's net earnings for the quarter reached $92.5 million, or $1.65 per share, an increase from $1.55 per share in the same period of the previous year. This profit figure beat consensus estimates. Total revenues grew to $871.2 million.
